in_sanskrit.name: द्रुशिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the cause of being seen or visible, manifested or apparent, seen in a vision or dream, or a goddess of vision or sight

in_marathi.name: Drushika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of divine speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drushika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Drushika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word drush, which means 'to see'. This name is believed to be the name of the goddess of divine speech. She is revered as the goddess of eloquence and is often invoked for the power of speech.
